objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-unusual-count-of-users-failed-to-authenticate-using-ntlm
objects.description: The following analytic identifies a source endpoint failing to authenticate multiple valid users using the NTLM protocol, potentially indicating a Password Spraying attack. It leverages Event 4776 from Domain Controllers, calculating the standard deviation for each host and applying the 3-sigma rule to detect anomalies.
